name: Martyrdom Healing
body:
You can channel your own life force out through your hands.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Diehard, lay on hands

Benefit: You may expend your own hit points to provide healing when using lay on hands; the exchange rate is three hit points for one point of healing. For example, if you deal 30 points of damage to yourself, you may heal another character of 10 points of damage.

Normal: A paladin can heal 1d6 hit points of damage for every two paladin levels she possesses.

Special: These additional points can also be used to damage undead.
